# ADR-3012: A01: Documented partner impersonation flow for support desk 12

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

Impersonation is sensitive and often necessary for support.

## Decision

Support tools MAY adopt a documented partner impersonation flow for support desk 12 (A01-12) when assisting end users.

## Consequences

Every impersonation session is time-boxed and logged.
